words.gloss_range: disconnected interrogative particle that redirects the discourse into a corrective rhetorical challenge
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْ}} ({{tr:am}}) does not open a neutral alternative. It turns the argument from the prior question about direct unseen knowledge in 53:35 into a fresh rebuking question about whether mediated scriptural report was received. The particle keeps both sides of its force visible: a branching interrogative surface and a corrective push, so the ayah begins as a challenge rather than as narrative. Its clipped pairing with the following negation gives the turn an abrupt audible launch before the heavier report verb arrives.

words.gloss_range: jussive negator that makes the following imperfect verb a past-negated rhetorical challenge with present force
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) fixes the clause as negated before the report-content appears. It governs the following passive imperfect as jussive, so the question is not simple present reporting but a challenge over a failure of reception that already should have been resolved. The negation scopes over the act of being informed, not over the scriptures themselves, which keeps the deficiency on the recipient's side. In the interrogative frame, that negative shape presses for rebuke: has he not already been informed?

topics.reason: The negator immediately governs the passive reporting verb, while the content complement comes afterward through the prepositional phrase.

words.gloss_range: passive Form II reporting verb: to be made aware of consequential report, with the informer suppressed and the content supplied through the following prepositional complement
words.root_gloss_range: consequential news, informing, and prophetic-report associations; the local form selects passive receipt of weighty report rather than direct seeing, bare announcement, or an active informing agent
words.prose: {{ar:يُنَبَّأْ}} ({{tr:yunabbaʾ}}) is the hinge of the ayah: after the opening particles, it makes the issue being informed, and before the content phrase it prepares a report that must be supplied from scripture. Under the preceding negation, the passive imperfect is governed as a missed reception with continuing force. Its passive Form II shape foregrounds the recipient while leaving the informer unnamed, so the claimant from 53:35 is demoted from one who allegedly sees to one who depends on transmitted news. The root keeps the report weighty rather than casual, its prophetic-report field suits the Mosaic scripture source, and the Form II doubling makes the transfer feel deliberate, not merely a passing notice. The content then arrives through a prepositional complement rather than as a direct object, which separates recipient from informational payload. Its rare passive profile and same-surah contrast with direct revelation in 53:10 make the channel distinction visible: not seeing the unseen, but receiving consequential documentary report. The qiraat and hamza observations stay at the level of recitational pressure; they do not change the passive report structure.

The recipient is informed about what follows; the content does not float as a detached topic or become a direct object. Because the preposition is fused to the relative head, it visibly starts a nested chain: report, content-slot, location in written pages, then prophetic attribution. Its content value is primary here, while the broader mediation feel supports the ayah's movement through transmitted scripture.

The result is a compact content-package inside the rhetorical question rather than a quotation of the scriptural material.

Because the container is a writing surface, the locative sense naturally carries metonymic force: what is in the pages is the recorded content the report concerns. This keeps the ayah's authority documentary and inscribed, while still functioning as the grammatical narrowing of the open relative head.

words.gloss_range: plural construct noun for written sheets or scriptures, locally governed by the locative preposition and bound to Moses as source
words.root_gloss_range: flat surfaces, written sheets, collected pages, and related misreading branches; the local sense selects plural written scripture-sheets, not a dish, an abstract book-title, or actual misreading
words.prose: {{ar:صُحُفِ}} ({{tr:ṣuḥufi}}) is the documentary hinge of the ayah. It is governed by the locative preposition, so the pages are where the content is found, and it governs the following name in construct, so the same pages become a prophetic source. The plural construct keeps the material image of written sheets visible: not a single page, not a generic codex label, and not merely an abstract scripture title. That material pressure matters because the ayah asks about information preserved in a written medium, and the word's fricative texture makes this written-page term audibly distinct before the closing name. The absence of the article is resolved by construct attribution, making the phrase definite through Moses. Cross-surah rows connect this wording to the scripture formula in 87:19 and to the next ayah's extension in 53:37; locally, that means the Mosaic pages open a prophetic-source sequence rather than closing it. The misreading branch of the root is only a narrowed shadow here: it reminds that written transmission demands reading, while the selected sense remains authoritative written sheets.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive verb يُنَبَّأْ and the construction بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ join reception of a report to matter preserved in sheets.
baseline_models.mechanism: A consequential report is brought to a recipient and stabilized in writing, so the question tests reception of an inspectable record rather than possession of unaided knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Consequential news brought and reported supplies the received content and gives the passive verb epistemic weight.
A written sheet supplies the durable, inspectable medium in which the report is held.

changed_reading.before: A yes-or-no question about whether someone heard Mosaic teaching.
changed_reading.after: A challenge about whether consequential notice reached him in the durable form of a written archive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُنَبَّأْ presents the addressee as an endpoint, while صُحُفِ مُوسَى names an archive originating elsewhere and earlier.
baseline_models.mechanism: The report travels across place and generation; collected sheets keep dispersed transmission together long enough to arrive at a later recipient.

activation_trace.role: Coming from one place to another turns informing into an arrival across distance rather than a static possession.
Collected sheets supply an archival bundle capable of carrying an earlier source forward as a coherent record.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely cites an old scripture.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages the last link of an archival relay: an old report has crossed distance and time toward a present hearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative asks about successful informing, and both focus roots contain branches in which contact with a target or text can go wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: Nominal exposure need not produce accurate uptake: a message can deflect without scoring its target, and a written surface can be misread.

activation_trace.role: A shot that swerves without cutting supplies the image of notice arriving near its target yet leaving no mark.
Misreading from written sheets supplies a textual failure mode after physical access has already occurred.

changed_reading.before: Either the addressee was told or he was not.
changed_reading.after: The question can probe whether notice landed accurately enough to leave a mark, rather than merely passing within reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The informing root can image a clear route, while the sheets give that route a readable material form.
baseline_models.mechanism: Information does more than add facts: an archived report can lay out traversable ground toward an intended destination.

activation_trace.role: A clear path and easy ground supply the latent route-making function of being informed.
The written sheet supplies a stable surface on which the route can remain available to a later traveler.

changed_reading.after: The sheets may also function as a route laid out for the recipient, making later deviation culpable rather than directionless.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah separates desire-driven speech and conjectural naming from hidden divine impartation, descended delivery, and compelling warrant. The focus report therefore arrives through an authenticated relay rather than as one more circulating claim.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news is the item whose channel the surrounding contrasts authenticate.
Written sheets stabilize the authenticated report against self-produced alternatives.
Inclination of the self supplies the rejected source of speech against which the report's channel is defined.
Divine news and inspiration supply the authorized upstream source of the relay.
Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies delivery from a higher source.
Compelling proof supplies the warrant explicitly absent from invented names but implicit in the received archive.
Doubt and supposition supply the unstable rival mode that the written report displaces.

structural_cues: 53:3-4 oppose speech from desire to revelation; 53:23 and 53:28 oppose self-made naming and conjecture to descended authority.
The passive يُنَبَّأْ places the focus addressee as receiver rather than author of the report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the desire/revelation and conjecture/authority contrasts; I infer that the passive report in 53:36 belongs to the authenticated side of both contrasts, while the narrower alternative is simply that older teaching had been heard.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks whether any prior information reached him.
changed_reading.after: The verse confronts him with an authorized, document-stabilized report whose provenance differs from desire, naming, and conjecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding question posits direct possession and sight of hidden knowledge; the focus question opens a second epistemic channel, mediated consequential report preserved in writing.

activation_trace.role: Consequential report supplies mediated knowledge as the alternative to direct sight.
The written sheet supplies publicly transmissible evidence where private vision is unavailable.
Disclosure of a thing to a knower supplies the claimed epistemic possession tested by the first question.
Concealment from eyes defines the inaccessible object that direct knowledge would have to overcome.
Sight by eye or insight supplies the direct channel denied or questioned before the archival one is introduced.

structural_cues: 53:35 and 53:36 are adjacent interrogatives joined by أَمْ: does he possess hidden knowledge so that he sees, or was he not informed from the sheets?
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct-seeing question followed by a reported-writing question; I infer two competing routes to knowledge, while a live alternative treats أَمْ as a fresh rebuke rather than a strict epistemic disjunction.

changed_reading.before: The Mosaic sheets enter as an isolated historical citation.
changed_reading.after: The sheets are the mediated evidentiary channel that answers a failed claim to see the hidden directly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same figure turns away, gives little, and stops as if excavation met hard ground. Those actions activate the focus images of a shot that fails to scratch and a sheet that can be misread: the report can arrive yet fail to penetrate conduct.

activation_trace.role: The deflected shot supplies the image of notification reaching the recipient's vicinity without scoring him.
Misreading written sheets supplies a second way for available notice to fail in uptake.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the recipient's active evasion of the incoming notice.
Smallness supplies the minimal response that precedes complete arrest.
Hard earth stopping excavation supplies the resistant substrate on which the report leaves no cut.
A little giving followed by cessation ties failed uptake to the observable interruption of action.

structural_cues: 53:33-36 sustain one singular figure through turning away, curtailed giving, claimed knowledge, and the passive informing question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal and hard-stop images; I infer a causal arrow from recipient resistance to the report's failure to mark conduct, while simple prior ignorance remains a materially live alternative.

changed_reading.before: He may have acted badly because the information never reached him.
changed_reading.after: The notice may have reached him but glanced off a turned-away, hardened recipient, making the issue resisted uptake rather than absent transmission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contents that follow form a nontransferable account: completion without deficit, no shifting another's load, one's own directed work, its disclosure, and exact full settlement. The sheets become an operative ledger rather than a merely antique document.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news introduces rules weighty enough to govern the ensuing account.
Collected sheets supply the ledger-like archive whose contents unfold clause by clause.
Completion without deficiency sets the account's initial norm of nothing left short.
A heavy burden supplies the liability that remains attached to its own bearer.
The non-dominant mapped image of inclination supplies load-shifting as the movement that the negation blocks.
Work and acquisition supply the personally generated entry credited to the human being.
Showing and making visible supply disclosure of the otherwise latent work.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies settlement of the disclosed entry.
Fullness without deficit closes the sequence with complete settlement.

structural_cues: 53:37-41 continue as a chained sequence of وَأَنَّ clauses after the reference to what is in the sheets.
53:38 repeats the burden root across carrier, carrying, and carried burden, grammatically resisting substitution.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden, own work, disclosure, recompense, and fullness in one sequence; I infer an accounting mechanism binding them, while the live alternative is a doctrinal list without a ledger-like functional unity.

changed_reading.before: The sheets are a source citation for several moral propositions.
changed_reading.after: The sheets expose a nontransferable account in which each burden and effort stays indexed to its bearer until fully disclosed and settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following traces, straying, an extended path, and gentle direction activate the informing root's clear-ground branch. The written archive functions as a navigable route whose availability makes turning away a directional choice.

activation_trace.role: Clear path and easy ground supply the focus report's route-making affordance.
The written sheet keeps the route legible beyond the original act of guidance.
Tracking one trace after another supplies the rival route of following conjecture.
Deviation from guidance and intended direction supplies the consequence of leaving the archival route.
An extended traversable road makes the route mechanism explicit in the surrounding judgment.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies the successful counterpart to straying.

structural_cues: 53:28-30 move from following conjecture to straying from His path and being guided; 53:33 then presents the same figure turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated tracking, path, straying, and guidance language; I infer that the focus branch makes informing function as route provision, while the alternative is that these are independent moral metaphors.

changed_reading.before: Being informed adds scriptural facts to the hearer's knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Being informed lays out traversable guidance in an archive, so refusal is a turn off an available road rather than lack of orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A broad written surface containing matter is set beside knowledge of embryos hidden inside bellies, forbidden self-purification, and the unseen hidden from eyes. The archive becomes a controlled opening of interiors that the addressee cannot certify from himself.

activation_trace.role: Flat spread and breadth supply the exposed surface on which otherwise interior matter becomes available.
Consequential report moves knowledge of concealed matters onto that exposed surface.
Disclosure to the knower frames both origin and moral restraint as matters of superior knowledge.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies one inaccessible interior known before self-awareness.
The inside of a thing supplies the containing depth paired with the phrase 'what is in the sheets.'
Purity and rectitude supply the inner status that people are forbidden to certify for themselves.
What is concealed from eyes extends the interiority mechanism from womb and self to hidden knowledge generally.

structural_cues: 53:32 and 53:36 both use فِي to place significant matter inside a container: embryos in bellies and teachings in sheets.
The sequence moves from 'do not declare yourselves pure' to a claim of hidden knowledge and then to received written disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated containment, superior knowledge, and blocked self-certification; I infer a surface-to-interior disclosure mechanism, while the live alternative is that the repeated spatial language is incidental.

changed_reading.before: The preposition in 'what is in the sheets' merely locates textual content.
changed_reading.after: The broad sheet opens a governed view into hidden origin and liability, countering the recipient's attempt to know or certify himself from the inside.

context_deltas.mechanism: The old archive is reactivated as a present warning: a former notice arrives again as renewed discourse precisely when the warned event has drawn near. Archival age and present urgency reinforce rather than cancel each other.

activation_trace.role: Arrival from another place supplies the report's crossing from an earlier source into the present address.
Collected sheets preserve the old notice so that it can be reactualized.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the present force of material inherited from former warnings.
Priority and formerness supply the archive's temporal depth.
Drawing near converts inherited warning into immediate pressure.
Speech renewed as news supplies the event in which the old report becomes present discourse again.

structural_cues: 53:56 joins the deictic هَذَا to warnings called former; 53:57 immediately announces nearness, and 53:59 calls the address this discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies former warning, present deixis, nearness, and renewed discourse; I infer that the old sheets are being re-performed as current notice, while the live alternative identifies the present warner rather than the archive as the primary referent.

changed_reading.before: The report is a backward-looking reference to Mosaic documents.
changed_reading.after: The preserved report re-arrives as present warning, and its antiquity intensifies the culpability of treating the approaching event as new or astonishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from renewed news through astonished amusement and heedless raised-headed continuation to bending and obedient worship. Informing is therefore completed not by cognitive possession alone but by a reversal in bodily posture and action.

activation_trace.role: Consequential report supplies the information whose successful reception should alter response.
A clear road supplies the action-guiding dimension that carries report into embodied direction.
Renewed speech as news re-presents the archived report to the current audience.
Astonishment at the unfamiliar supplies a spectator response that stops short of changed conduct.
Continuation in diversion and heedlessness supplies the behavioral failure of reception.
Raised head and standing supply the initial posture reversed by the next imperative.
Bowing the head supplies the visible reversal from heedless elevation.
Humble obedience supplies the action in which consequential notice reaches completion.

structural_cues: 53:59-62 form a reaction sequence: marvel, laugh rather than weep, persist heedlessly, then receive paired imperatives to prostrate and worship.
The shift from raised-head imagery to head-bending imagery is an explicit bodily reversal across 53:61-62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies renewed discourse and a reaction-to-imperative sequence; I infer that changed posture is the downstream completion of informing, while the alternative is that the closing commands answer the surah as a whole without specifically redefining 53:36.

changed_reading.before: To be informed is to possess the report cognitively.
changed_reading.after: Consequential informing remains incomplete while the hearer only marvels or persists upright; reception is tested by movement into obedient posture.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The basin image is a concrete, form-distant branch and should not replace the lexical sense 'sheets'; it remains anchored by صُحُف and the locative فِي, and downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for bounded yet openly accessible contents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ places consequential matter inside a noun whose inventory includes a broad shallow receptacle.

activation_trace.role: Consequential news supplies what fills the imagined receptacle.
A broad shallow dish or basin supplies an open container image activated by the phrase 'what is in.'

changed_reading.before: The sheets are neutral carriers of writing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sheets resemble a shallow open repository: teachings are bounded and held, yet spread where a recipient can draw from them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The faint-sound branches are secondary and do not make يُنَبَّأْ or وَحْي denote mere noise; the activation remains anchored in the informing root and the packet's matching acoustic branch, and should be rendered as an analogy for a subtle signal later made public.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُنَبَّأْ contains a faint-sound branch that can coexist with its ordinary report branch.

activation_trace.role: A faint uncertain sound supplies the low-salience signal that a resistant hearer can dismiss.
A hidden or quiet sound supplies a matching upstream acoustic image for revelation.
Speech renewed as news supplies the public amplification of what began as a subtle signal.

changed_reading.before: The addressee either received a clear report or received nothing.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a subtle signal has been amplified into renewed public discourse, yet he continues to treat consequential notice as background murmur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Textual misreading and the split-root marking image are unusual, historically extended branches, so they should not be asserted as the verse's direct denotation; they remain anchored in written صُحُف and in the context's self-applied names, and prose should qualify this as a transmission-integrity model.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The report is located in written sheets, whose inventory includes error caused by confusing what is inscribed.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news supplies the content vulnerable to corruption in reception.
Misreading through confused writing supplies the failure of transmission integrity.
A name as designation supplies the audience's self-authored indexing system.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible identifying mark makes naming function like an imposed inscription.
Supposition supplies the unreliable reading rule by which imposed labels displace the archived report.

changed_reading.before: Access to the written report guarantees that its content has been received.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the archive can be physically available while self-authored labels and conjecture corrupt its indexing, so the question tests accurate reception as well as access.

strongest_changes: The immediate 53:35 contrast reframed 53:36 as a mediated evidentiary channel answering a failed claim to see hidden knowledge directly.
53:37-41 turned 'what is in the sheets' into a nontransferable account joining own burden, own work, disclosure, and full settlement.
53:33-34 activated resisted uptake: notice may arrive yet fail to mark a recipient who turns away and stops at hard ground.
53:59-62 made informing performative, moving from renewed news and heedless uprightness to bent, obedient posture.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported several coexisting material mechanisms rather than one paraphrase: authenticated archive, report in transit, route, projectile, broad receptacle, quiet signal, and corruptible inscription. Context selected different functions without forcing them into a single final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether أَمْ makes 53:36 a strict alternative epistemic channel to 53:35 or begins a looser rebuke.
How far the projectile, basin, faint-sound, and misreading branches should shape downstream prose rather than remain diagnostic analogies.
Whether all of 53:37-41 should be treated syntactically as quoted sheet contents or as a thematically continuous elaboration.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Consequential news is already in written sheets.** ن ب ء B002 supplies a consequential report producing knowledge or strong probability; ص ح ف B002 supplies written sheets. The passive verb contrasts the inaccessible unseen of 53:35 with transmitted record. I infer that accountable action should follow available report rather than imagined secret knowledge; the ayah redirects evidence from speculation to communication.
2. **Flat sheets make hidden claims inspectable.** ص ح ف B001 supplies flat spread/breadth and B002 the written surface. I infer that writing externalizes content for review, countering self-serving inward conjecture. The ayah reads as an appeal to inspectable memory.
3. **Being informed is itself a movement of arrival.** ن ب ء B001 supplies coming from one place to another. The report travels from earlier sheets into the present challenge. I infer that authoritative memory crosses temporal distance through notification; the ayah reads as arrival of prior witness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:38-42 disclose the contents that this ayah leaves enclosed in the sheets: non-transfer, personal endeavor, visibility, full recompense, and endpoint. The later list makes the written report function as a compact carrier of an accountability system.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A documentary transmission chain counters private unseen knowledge.** `ن ب ء B002` supplies news brought and reported, `ن ب ء B003` informing from God, and `ص ح ف B002` a written sheet, with `ص ح ف B003` collected sheets in a codex. The question follows the claim to hidden sight and introduces a record whose contents are then enumerated in 53:38-41. The packet supplies report, durable writing, and subsequent propositions; I infer the arrow authorized report fixed in writing -> publicly checkable knowledge. The ayah reads as a demand for record-based reception, not a generic accusation of ignorance.

2. **The flat spread makes concealed principles inspectable.** `ص ح ف B001` supplies flat spread and breadth. The compact claims that follow are distributed across separate ayat like items laid out for inspection. The packet supplies a spread surface and enumerated content; I infer the material arrow inscription spread out -> claims available for comparison. This latent branch gives `صحف` an evidentiary surface role alongside its ordinary written-sheet role.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:37-41 unfolded the sheets' evidentiary function by moving from embodied fulfillment through three account rules to complete recompense.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalın temelini bir şeydeki yayılma ve genişlik olarak kurar; yeryüzünün görünen yüzü ile insan yüzünün derisini de bu geniş yüzey düşüncesinin özel gerçekleşmeleri olarak verir. Bu nedenle sunulan dal kimliği kaynak anlatımıyla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yazı yaprağını, bağlı yapraklar bütününü, yayvan kabı veya okuma yanlışını değil; yayılmış geniş yüzeyi ve buna bağlı özel kullanımları anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel yayılma ve geniş yüzey çekirdeğini korurken yeryüzü ve yüz derisi gibi kalıplaşmış kullanımları bu çekirdekten ayrı özel yüzey adları olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin yayılıp geniş bir yüzey oluşturması ya da böyle yayılmış yüzeyin kendisidir. Yeryüzünün görünen yüzü ve insan yüzünün dış derisi bu çekirdeğin özel adlandırmalarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin yayılması ve geniş bir yüzey görünümü kazanması temel anlamdır.
Yeryüzünün görünen yüzü, yayılmış geniş yüzeyin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.
İnsan yüzünün dış derisi, geniş ve açık yüzey düşüncesine bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yayılma ve genişliği temel alır; görünen yeryüzü ile yüz derisini de bu yüzey kavrayışına bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı, üzerine yazı yazılan ya da yazı taşıyan tek yaprak ve kimi kullanımda kitap olarak açıkça tanımlar; ayrıca bunun çoğul biçimlerini verir. Sunulan yazılı yaprak çerçevesi bu içeriği doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tek yazı yaprağı ile ondan oluşan kitap kullanımını kapsar; yüz derisi, yayvan kap, yaprakları kapaklar arasında toplama işlemi ve yanlış okuma bunun dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yazı yaprağı anlamında kalır ve yalnızca kaynakta bulunan kitap genişlemesini içerir; başka dallardaki toplama işlemi tanıma taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzerine yazı yazılan veya yazı taşıyan yaprak ya da parçadır; kimi kullanımda bu tür yazılı yapraklardan oluşan kitabı da belirtir. Tekil adın çeşitli çoğul biçimleri vardır.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, deri veya benzeri bir malzemeden olup üzerine yazı yazılan ya da yazı taşıyan tek yapraktır.
Aynı ad kimi kullanımda yazılı yaprakların oluşturduğu kitap için de kullanılır.
Kaynak ifadesi tekil yazı yaprağı için birden çok çoğul biçim bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yazı yazılan yaprak veya parçayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; kitap kullanımını ve tekil adın farklı çoğul biçimlerini de aynı dalda kaydeder.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın gönderimi geniş ve yayvan bir çanaktır; aynı birleşik iddia ayrıca aynı ad ailesindeki çoğul biçimi küçük su biriktirme yerleri için de verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak ikinci gönderimin çanak tanımına özdeş değil, ona biçim ve işlev bakımından bağlı ayrı bir uzantı olduğu belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek geniş, yayvan çanaktır; küçük su biriktirme çukurları ayrı bir uzantıdır ve yazı yaprağı ya da genel geniş yüzey anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kap adını çekirdekte tutar ve kaynakta açıkça verilen küçük su biriktirme yeri kullanımını bağımlı bir uzantı olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Geniş ağızlı, yayvan bir çanaktır. Aynı ad ailesindeki çoğul biçim ayrıca su tutmak için yapılan küçük biriktirme çukurlarını da belirtebilir.

facets.statement: Temel nesne geniş ağızlı, basık ve yayvan bir çanaktır.
Aynı ad ailesinin çoğul biçimi, su için yapılan küçük biriktirme çukurlarını da adlandırabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Birleşik kaynak anlatımı geniş ve yayvan çanağı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; ayrıca aynı ad ailesinin küçük su biriktirme yerlerine yönelen ayrı kullanımını kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: yayvan çanak; küçük su biriktirme çukuru
concept_gloss.applicability: Çanak çekirdeği ile aynı ad ailesindeki su biriktirme yeri uzantısını birbirine karıştırmadan birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş yayvan kabı ve küçük su biriktirme yeri uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geniş ağızlı ve basık kap çekirdeğinin söz konusu olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş ağızlı, basık ve yayvan kap çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Küçük su biriktirme çukurlarına yönelik uzantıyı karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ad ailesinin küçük su toplama yerlerini belirttiği özel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Su tutmak için yapılan küçük biriktirme yeri kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Geniş ve yayvan çanak çekirdeğini karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yayvan çanağın yanında küçük su biriktirme çukurları uzantısını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle yemek konan büyük kabı ve ona benzetilen küçük kuyuyu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Geniş bir yemek kabı iki dalın en yakın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kabın yayvan ve basık biçimini öne çıkarır ve su çukurlarına uzanır; komşu dal yemek sunma işlevini öne çıkarır ve küçük kuyu benzetmesine uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal geniş, yayvan çanağı ve küçük su biriktirme çukurlarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal su veya çamaşır için kullanılan daha derin tekne ve leğen türlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Su ya da başka bir içerik tutan geniş kap görünümü iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yayvan çanak biçimi kurucudur; komşu dalın kabı daha çok yıkama veya su tutma işleviyle belirlenen leğen ya da tekne türündedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli olarak yayvan çanağı ve küçük su biriktirme çukurunu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bardak, havuz, kap, oluk ve oyulmuş toplama yeri gibi çok çeşitli su veya yemek toplayıcılarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir sıvıyı ya da yemeği içinde toplama işlevi iki dalda kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal biçimce yayvan çanakla sınırlı bir çekirdeğe sahiptir; komşu dal ise biçimden çok toplama işlevi çevresinde farklı kap ve yer türlerini birleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal genişliğin kendisini değil, geniş ve basık belirli bir kap türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeydeki yayılma ve geniş yüzeyi, yeryüzü ve yüz derisi kullanımlarıyla birlikte anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yayvan kabın geniş ve açılmış yüzeyi, iki dal arasında biçimsel bir yakınlık kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal somut bir kap veya su biriktirme yeridir; komşu dal ise genel yüzey genişliğini anlatır ve kap olma şartı taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kap biçimi, su tutma işlevi ve geniş yüzeyle karışabilecek sınırları gösteren dört komşu seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çekirdeği, birbirine benzeyen harfler yüzünden yazılı metni yanlış okumak veya aslından farklı aktarmaktır. Sunulan çerçeve doğrudur; ancak kaynak ayrıca bu hatayı yapan aktarıcıyı belirten bağlı bir kişi kullanımını da içerdiğinden sınır buna göre genişletilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız genel yanılmayı değil, harf benzerliğinin doğurduğu yanlış okuma veya aktarımı ve buna bağlı kişi adlandırmasını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım olay çekirdeğini, harf benzerliği koşulunu ve yanlışı aktaran kişiye özgü bağlı kullanımı ayrı tutar; genel belirsizlik anlamına genişletmez.

concept_map.definition: Yazılı bir metni, birbirine benzeyen harfleri karıştırarak yanlış okumak veya aslından farklı aktarmaktır. Aynı dal, bu tür bir okuma hatasını aktarımında yapan kişiyi de niteleyebilir.

facets.statement: Kurucu olay, benzer harflerin karıştırılması yüzünden yazılı metnin yanlış okunması veya yanlış aktarılmasıdır.
Bağlı kişi kullanımı, yazılı metni benzer harfleri karıştırarak yanlış aktaran kimseyi belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların birleşik anlatımı, benzer harflerin karıştırılmasıyla doğan yanlış okuma veya aktarımı temel alır ve bu yanlışı aktaran kişiyi belirten kullanımı da içerir.

concept_gloss.text: harf benzerliğinden doğan yanlış okuma veya aktarım
concept_gloss.applicability: Hatanın nedenini, okuma aşamasını ve yanlış aktarım sonucunu birlikte karşılayan genel açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Benzer harf koşulunu, yanlış okumayı ve metnin yanlış aktarılmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hatanın doğrudan okuma sırasında gerçekleştiği bağlamlarda doğal bir eylem karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Benzer harflerin karıştırılmasıyla oluşan yanlış okuma olayını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yanlış okumanın başkasına aktarılması sonucunu ve kişi kullanımını karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Benzer harfleri karıştırdığı için okuduğu metni yanlış aktaran kişiden söz edilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yanlış okumayı aktarımına taşıyan kişi kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek başına olay adı olarak yanlış okuma ve aktarım sürecini karşılamaz.
error_profile.collision: Neden açıkça belirtilmezse başka tür aktarım yanlışlarını da çağrıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, harf benzerliğinin giderilememesi yüzünden ortaya çıkan yanlış okuma veya aktarımı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, işaret veya noktalar ekleyerek harfler arasındaki belirsizliği giderme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak ekseni, yazıdaki benzer harflerin ayırt edilmesi veya karıştırılmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ayırt edememenin doğurduğu hatalı sonucu, komşu dal ise harfleri işaretleyerek aynı belirsizliği ortadan kaldıran karşıt işlemi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yazılı metinde benzer harflerden doğan belirli bir okuma ve aktarım hatasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal sanı, kuruntu, genel benzerlik, belirsizlik ve bir kişiden kuşkulanma alanlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Benzer görünen şeylerin birbirine karıştırılması iki dalda ortak bir bilişsel zemindir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yazıdaki harflerin karışmasına ve metnin yanlış okunmasına bağlıdır; komşu dal ise yazı şartı olmadan daha genel kuşku ve benzerlik durumlarını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal benzer harfleri karıştıran okuyucunun yaptığı somut okuma veya aktarım hatasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi ya da sözün anlamını başkası için bilerek veya fiilen kapalı ve karışık hale getirmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir metnin anlaşılmasını zorlaştıran karışıklık iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal okuyucunun harf benzerliği yüzünden düştüğü hatadır; komşu dal ise nesne veya anlam üzerinde belirsizlik yaratan işlemi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın koşulu yazılı harflerin birbirine benzemesi, sonucu ise yanlış okuma veya aktarımdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir işin, anlatımın veya karanlığın karışıp belirsizleşmesini genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karışıklığın doğru ayrımı engellemesi her iki dalda da bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yazıya, harf benzerliğine ve okuma sonucuna özgüdür; komşu dal daha genel bir karıştırma ve belirsizleşme alanına sahiptir.
